citation.authors: Daniels G, Fraser A, Westgate G

cited_by.title: Hair breakage, growth and keeping length

record.population: Review of hair-fibre studies across hair types
record.finding: Curlier hair has a smaller, elliptical cross-section. Fragility is attributed to knotting and cracking rather than to a structural weakness. Sources disagree on water uptake. The review calls the eight-type curl system possibly too complex to reproduce.
